# syq 0.7.1

This patch strengthens single-part S3 upload integrity and exercises the faster
release pipeline introduced since 0.7.0.

Single-part uploads with a SHA-256 request checksum now reuse that digest for
signed payload validation, including delegated uploads. Providers such as
Tigris can reject corrupted payloads through this check without an additional
hashing pass. Multipart and MD5-based uploads retain their existing behavior.
There are no CLI or saved-state changes.

Release preparation reuses eligible validation and Cargo caches, overlaps
native builds with validation, and packages Python wheels from the verified
native executables while SDK checks run. Publication retains its validation,
signing and artifact-verification gates.
